artworks.title: Omer Talon
artworks.artist: Jean Morin after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man in a bust-length portrait. The man is facing forward with a prominent nose, slightly pursed lips, deep-set eyes, and short, slightly wavy hair. He is depicted wearing a formal, high-collared garment with a large collar and draped fabric, revealing a buttoned-up undershirt. The background features an intricately patterned geometrical frame.

artworks.title: Marguerite Lemon
artworks.artist: Jean Morin after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image shows an upper half portrait of a person portrayed in an engraving. The person is positioned slightly turned to the viewer's left, looking directly at the viewer. They have a soft, round face with a serene expression, curly hair framing their face, and a piece secured at the back with a ribbon. They wear a garment with textured fabric draped over their shoulders, and a string of pearls around their neck. Their hands are clasped gracefully at chest level. The portrait is set within an intricately designed frame with a geometric pattern in the background.

artworks.title: Pierre Maugis
artworks.artist: Jean Morin after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper half of a man's body. He is positioned facing slightly towards the right with his head turned to look directly at the viewer. The man has facial hair, prominent cheekbones, deep-set eyes, and shoulder-length curly hair. He is wearing a dark, draped garment with a white collar and a decorative tassel hanging from a string at his neck. The background features a textured surface with an intricately designed frame with inscriptions along its borders.

artworks.title: Nicolas de Netz
artworks.artist: Jean Morin after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.description: The image shows a half-length portrait of an older man seated. He faces forward but is slightly turned to the side. The man has a slender face with a prominent nose and a faint smile. He has medium-length, slightly wavy hair and is wearing a skullcap. He is dressed in formal ecclesiastical attire, including a large collar and robes. He wears a cross pendant around his neck. The image is framed in an octagonal design with embossed text around it and a shaded background, emphasizing the detailed engravings of his clothing and facial features. The overall tone is monochromatic.

artworks.title: Nicolas Colbert
artworks.artist: Nicolas Pitau I after Claude Lefebvre
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a man within an oval medallion. The man has an oval face with soft features, curly medium-length hair, and is wearing clerical attire with a large white collar and a dark cape or robe. He has a cross around his neck. The background features a circular border with text, and beneath the portrait is a coat of arms with a snake coiled around a staff inside a shield. The image is highly detailed and engraved.

artworks.title: Perefixe de Beaumont
artworks.artist: Nicolas Pitau I after Pierre Mignard I
artworks.description: The image shows a man portrayed from the chest up. He is facing slightly left, with his head turned toward the viewer. The man has distinct facial features with a prominent nose and visible wrinkles, and his hair is wavy, falling to his shoulders. He is dressed in formal clerical attire with a large collar, robe, and an insignia on his chest. An oval frame surrounds him with Latin text along its border, two stars are outside the frame on either side of the oval, and a heraldic shield with a coat of arms is at the bottom. The background consists of fine lines creating a textured appearance.

artworks.title: Thierry Bignon
artworks.artist: Nicolas Pitau I after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a man from the waist up, inside an oval frame. He is facing right, with a three-quarter angle view of his profile. The man has a long, narrow face with a pronounced chin, straight nose, and expressionless expression. He has long wavy hair reaching his shoulders, and wears a formal, period-appropriate outfit with a wide collar and textured outer garment. There are inscriptions in Latin around the portrait. The background features an ornate oval including a coat of arms at the bottom, set against a patterned backdrop.

artworks.title: Pierre le Moyne
artworks.artist: Francois de Poilly I after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man. He is depicted from the chest upwards, slightly angled to the left, with a direct gaze. The man has a prominent forehead, expressive eyes, and a subtle smile. His short, slightly wavy hair falls around his forehead and ears. He is dressed in a high-collared garment, possibly a robe or clerical attire, with a cape or wide collar. The background features an oval frame, giving the portrait a formal look. Below the portrait is an inscription in a decorative scroll with a shield emblem. The setting suggests a historical or classical style, with the background and inscription adding to the portrait's significance.

artworks.title: Nicolas Parfait
artworks.artist: Nicolas de Poilly after Claude Lefebvre
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a person displaying their upper torso. The person is positioned facing forward, slightly turned to their left, with their body about three-quarters visible. They have a rounded face with distinct features, such as a prominent nose and full lips, and their hair is curly and shoulder-length. They wear a dark, buttoned-up garment with a wide, white collar. The background is an oval frame within a rectangular engraving, with intricate scripting around the person's portrait that identifies them. Below the oval frame is an ornate coat of arms.

artworks.title: Louis XIV
artworks.artist: Peter Ludwig van Schuppen after Wallerant Vaillant
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the chest up. The man is facing slightly to his right, with his head turned towards the viewer. He has a composed expression, with dark eyes and pronounced facial features including a distinct nose and closed lips. His hair is curly and full, extending to his shoulders. He is wearing a high, wide-collared shirt or garment and there is a decorative ribbon on his shoulder. The portrait is set within an ornate oval frame with floral motifs and ribbon-like designs. Below the frame is an emblem with a crown, fleur-de-lis, and an inscription in Latin. The background features detailed drapery and motifs suggesting a regal or formal setting.

artworks.title: Michel Colbert
artworks.artist: Peter Ludwig van Schuppen after Claude Lefebvre
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man with a pronounced nose, deep-set eyes, and a soft expression. He has medium-length, wavy hair parted with a visible tonsure, indicating he may be a member of the clergy. The man wears religious attire, including a high-collared garment with detailed patterns and a large cross pendant. The background features an ornate oval frame with Latin inscriptions, and at the bottom, there is an emblem or coat of arms with classical motifs. The style suggests an engraving or etching.

artworks.title: Langlois de Blancfort
artworks.artist: Peter Ludwig van Schuppen
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man looking directly at the viewer. He has long curly hair, a prominent nose, deep-set eyes, and a slight smile. He is wearing formal attire with a lace collar draped over his shoulders. The portrait is set within an ornate oval frame with decorative scrollwork and motifs. The background includes ornate architectural elements.

artworks.title: Charles de Houel de Morainville
artworks.artist: Peter Ludwig van Schuppen after Pieter van Mol
artworks.description: This image shows a man from the waist up, facing the viewer in an ornate oval frame. He has long, wavy hair, a mustache, and is dressed in period clothing with a suit of armor. The frame is decorated with ribbons, a crest, and intricate patterns.

artworks.title: Nicolas Le Camus
artworks.artist: Peter Ludwig van Schuppen after Pieter van Mol
artworks.description: The image shows a man from mid-chest upwards. He is facing forward but slightly turned to his right. The man has a round face with a prominent nose and full lips. He has thick, curly hair extending down to his shoulders. He wears a formal robe with a wide, white collar. Surrounding him is an elaborate oval frame with classical motifs and a coat of arms at the bottom, including two greyhounds and a swan. The background includes decorative engravings and text encircling the figure.

artworks.title: Cardinal Jules Mazarin
artworks.artist: Peter Ludwig van Schuppen after Pierre Mignard I
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a man. He is depicted from the upper half of his body, slightly turned to the side, with a solemn expression. The man has distinct facial features, a mustache, and shoulder-length wavy hair. He wears an ornate garment with a large collar and coat adorned with buttons. The portrait is surrounded by an intricate oval frame with four illustrative panels at the corners, each showing different scenes and Latin inscriptions. The top of the frame features an angel emblem, while the bottom has a crest with shield and scrollwork. The background is detailed with elaborate line work.

artworks.title: Mary I Stuart
artworks.artist: Jonas Suyderhoff after Pieter Claesz Soutman after Gerrit van Honthorst
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman with distinct facial features. She faces slightly to her left with her head turned towards the viewer. She has large eyes, arched eyebrows, a small nose, and a composed expression. Her long, curly hair falls over her shoulders and she wears a string of pearls on her head. She is elegantly dressed in a garment with a lacy neckline and a pearl necklace. The portrait is framed with intricate designs of cherubs, floral patterns, and mythical creatures. The background is textured and there is an inscription below the portrait identifying the woman.

artworks.title: John, Count of Nassau
artworks.artist: Jonas Suyderhoff after Pieter Claesz Soutman after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image depicts a detailed portrait of a man, showing his bust. The man is facing forward with his body slightly turned to his right, showcasing his attire. His facial features include a beard, mustache, curly hair, eyebrows, and expressive eyes. He is wearing an elaborate garment with a high, lace-trimmed collar. He is adorned with a sash or chain across his shoulder. The background features ornate decorations of fruit, flowers, and leaves. The border is highly decorative.

artworks.title: Franciscus de Moncada
artworks.artist: Jonas Suyderhoff after Pieter Claesz Soutman, after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a man from the chest up. He is facing forward with his head slightly turned to the right. The man has a round face with a pronounced forehead, a prominent mustache, and short, wavy hair that seems to be receding slightly. He wears a high-collared shirt and richly adorned armor. The frame around the portrait is decorated with carved elements resembling fruits, vegetables, and foliage, with a draped fabric at the top. The background has a textured, patterned design in line with the ornate frame.

artworks.title: Philip III, King of Spain
artworks.artist: Jonas Suyderhoff
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the shoulders up. He is facing slightly left, with his head turned right. The man has a mustache and beard, short combed-back hair, and wears a high ruffled collar and an intricate garment. A decorative ribbon is visible across his chest. The portrait is framed by elaborate illustrations of foliage, fruits, and intricate designs, against a dark background.

artworks.title: Johann von Erlach
artworks.artist: Johann Georg Wille after Carlo Francesco Rusca, Cavalier
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated in an upright position. His face is visible with distinct features such as a full face, small eyes, and a straight nose. He has curly light hair that falls around his shoulders. He is dressed in an opulent robe with voluminous sleeves and buttons, a white ruffled shirt visible at the cuffs and collar, and a decorative medallion around his neck. He is holding a staff with an ornate handle in his right hand. On a table nearby are a hat, potentially books, and a tassel. A piece of armor with a feathered plume is in the foreground. The background features a draped curtain and a textured wall.

artworks.title: Nicolas Rene Berryer
artworks.artist: Johann Georg Wille after Jean-François Delyen
artworks.description: The image depicts a man seated at a table with an open book in front of him. He has long white hair, a serious expression, and is wearing formal attire typical of the era. The background includes heavy curtains and a shelf with books.

artworks.title: J.P. Bignon
artworks.artist: Benoît Audran I after Joseph Vivien
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a man's body. He is facing slightly to his right with his head turned towards the viewer. He has curly hair falling around his face and down to his shoulders. His facial features include arched eyebrows and a serious expression. He wears a formal, high-collared garment with a pleated ruffle. The portrait is encased within an ornate oval frame with inscriptions, and a decorative emblem is below the frame. The background features finely detailed horizontal lines.

artworks.title: Bishop Hoadly
artworks.artist: Bernard Baron after William Hogarth
artworks.description: The image shows a man in clerical attire seated in an ornate chair. He is in a slightly turned position, with one arm resting on the chair and the other hand gesturing or resting on a surface. He has a round face, a double chin, large eyes, and styled curly hair. He wears a cape with decorative shoulder piece, a ruffled shirt with lace cuffs, and multiple necklaces. The background includes a draped curtain and intricate details that suggest a stained glass window and a book.

artworks.title: Hieronymus van Beverningk
artworks.artist: Abraham Blooteling after Nicolaes Maes
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of an elderly man facing slightly left and looking at the viewer. He has long, wavy hair falling to his shoulders and a serious expression on his face. He is dressed in a dark coat with a patterned cravat at his neck. The portrait is enclosed in an oval frame with decorative leaves and Latin text. Below the portrait is a heraldic crest featuring a lion and a panel with ornate script.
